steps.title: bin/dotpals.js
Run setup with --yes and run the tests

body.command: cd /c/Dot; node --check bin/dotpals.js && echo ok; T=$(mktemp -d); export DOTPALS_HOME="$T"; export DOTPALS_ELECTRON="~/.dotpals/node_modules/electron/dist/electron.exe"; timeout 180 node bin/dotpals.js setup --yes --no-claude --no-start --no-path 2>&1 | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | sed -n '/Settings in/,$p'; rm -rf "$T"; timeout 150 npm test > "$TEMP/t.out" 2>&1; grep -E "^ℹ (pass|fail)" "$TEMP/t.out"
